component.name: QuickSnipp
component.summary: Fast snipping tool — capture, annotate, copy

description.p: QuickSnipp is a lightweight snipping tool for Wayland and X11 that stays out of your way: click New Snip, drag a rectangle anywhere on screen — across monitors too — and the capture opens in a small editor.

Annotate with pen, arrows, lines, rectangles and text, crop with an adjustable selection, undo and redo your edits, then copy straight to the clipboard with Ctrl+C. Nothing is ever saved to disk unless you press Save.

ul.li: Click-drag screen capture with multi-monitor support
Pen, arrow, line, rectangle and text annotations
Copy to clipboard with Ctrl+C or the right-click menu
Optional PNG export — no files unless you ask for them
Works on Wayland (via the XDG portal) and X11
